The issue occurs because R8 code shrinking is enabled for the release build (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), which strips generic `Signature` attributes and obfuscates anonymous class definitions by default. Gson's `TypeToken` relies on bytecode generic signature metadata at runtime to resolve the target parameterized type (`List<Book>`).

The fix has been applied to [proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-B-r3/work/app/proguard-rules.pro):

- Added `-keepattributes Signature` and related attributes (`*Annotation*`, `EnclosingMethod`, `InnerClasses`) so generic type signatures are preserved across classes and methods.
- Added rules to keep `TypeToken` and its subclasses (`-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken`).
- Added rules to retain the data model classes and fields in `vn.shelftap.lab.model.**` so Gson can reflectively populate `Book` instances upon deserialization.
